_about: Spy and espionage: a mission, a cover that must hold, an asset to run, and a double agent somewhere close. Story axes for story_gen.py. Each axis is rolled on its own; an entry is a string (weight 1) or {v, w, decay}. All text is our own.

mission: steal a ledger of bribes from a minister's safe
turn a diplomat at an embassy party
find out who sold the codes
bring a defecting scientist across the border
plant a bug in a casino owner's office
photograph a ship's cargo at Laem Chabang port
stop an assassination at a summit in Singapore
recover a lost agent's notebook in Vientiane
agency: a small service everyone thinks is a joke
a handler who has not slept in a week
an old network left over from the cold war
a private intelligence firm with clients on both sides
a ministry section that officially does not exist
a handler who once worked for the other side
a service in the middle of a purge
a retired spymaster pulling strings from a care home
cover: a writer for a travel magazine
a wine importer with a real business
a junior attaché at the embassy
a backpacker on a long gap year
a night manager at a Bangkok hotel
the cook on a cargo ship
a married couple on a second honeymoon
asset: a bored translator at the ministry
a casino croupier who hears everything
a general's mistress with expensive tastes
a hacker who wants a new passport
a priest who hears the wrong confessions
a customs officer at the port, deep in debt
a Mekong ferryman who knows every face
tell: they never ask what the mission is for
they always know which route was safe
a second phone they say is for family
money that arrives right after each leak
they flinch at a name that should mean nothing
their reports are a little too clean
they once served in the enemy chief's city
they always volunteer for the dead drops
extraction: a fishing boat off the Gulf coast at dawn
a sleeper train over the border
a diplomatic car with one seat left
a cargo plane that will not wait
a marathon crowd to vanish into
a monastery that asks no questions
a fake funeral and a real coffin
a night bus south to Penang

1: a small slip in the cover story
the same face seen twice in one day
3: the cover is blown to someone who matters
4: unmask the double agent, or be unmasked

cliches: the villain explains the whole plan
the seductress who is really the enemy
a scarred foreign agent with a thick accent
